finding.text: At 1920 and 3440 the model page's paragraphs run the full wide track, far past a reading measure (layout: sizing, line length) — layout.json widest_text 1079 at 1920 and 1706 at 3440; shots/…-navigation-model/3440.png, the intro paragraph and section 1 run ~200 characters a line. Keep the prose in the reading track and let only the cards and demos go wide.

The workspace demo page is 86–87% empty at 1920/3440 (layout.json empty 0.861 / 0.873): three panes holding one line each. It proves fill and zero padding, but a pane with some content would show it better.
"On this page" appears only from 1920 up (layout.json toc band absent at 1200), and at 3440 five of its entries wrap to 2 lines (toc-link wraps) because the column is narrow.

Keep list: the page says "81 before, 25 kept, 56 retired", but only Family tree has moved (manifest.json has one entry). The brief allows this (apply only unlinked pages), and the page says so plainly.
The parent page /framework/core/Page/navigation/ has tab_rows 3 at 1200. This was already there: the diff only adds one line and `children: "model"`.
The sidebar truncates the new page's label to "Navigation: one …" at every width (shots/…-navigation-model/1200.png, left rail). A shorter `label:` such as "One model" would fit.
